works.title: Mostima
works.subtitle: Malice
works.description:
A winged, bone-plated horse demon.
One of the demon kings seated among the “Satans.”

He holds the Enemy-Bone Bastion, commanding the legions of hatred.

Enemy bones are driven into his wings, nailed to him like medals.
His body is laced with cracks, as if hatred has wrapped around him to barely keep his shape; one more push, and he will shatter.

Hatred does not fade.
He executes again and again, remembers again and again, ferments again and again—until the moment it erupts.
Even when his body is already broken beyond repair, he still charges forward, walking the road of blood-debt and vengeance.

oneOfAKindWorks.title: S.A.T.A.N
oneOfAKindWorks.subtitle: Sin
oneOfAKindWorks.description: A 925 silver interchangeable jewelry system (Interchangeable jewelry systems). Built around a single core chassis, it combines 16 interchangeable main parts plus one pendant add-on and one ring add-on. By swapping the main part, you can change the silhouette, emblem, and overall presence-one piece, worn in multiple forms, shifting with the scene. Reconstructed from the names and legends of 16 demons, each form is distilled into a "vessel" of sin, carrying desires and obsessions too heavy to hold, and instincts pushed beyond control. Forged from fragments of demonic power and corroded malice, the unseen weight of sin becomes wearable silver armor.

about.text1: The spiritual intent of mortals, formed into wearable silver.
about.text2: Mortal Aura is a jewelry brand rooted in the language of mysticism, translating mythology, legend, and symbolic narrative into wearable silver works. At the core of the brand is the concept of the Six Aspects of Humanity, a framework developed by the designer through long-term making and observation as a way of naming and organizing the inner states of human existence. From this structure, Mortal Aura unfolds into six distinct yet interconnected collections: Mortalis, Malignance, Innocence, Bestia, Stellaveil, and Apotheosis. Within this framework, jewelry is regarded as a vessel for will, memory, order, and states of being.
about.text3: Defined by a palette of black and silver, the brand combines organic force, symbolic form, and a cold, sculptural hardness to create a distinctive style marked by mystique, solemnity, and an otherworldly aesthetic, presenting to the world the spiritual intent inherent in mortals themselves.
